title: Especialista em Tecnologia da Informação
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up , o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Desafio

Garantir que a área de Tecnologia da Informação seja um diferencial estratégico para a operação de Celulose, promovendo inovação, eficiência, segurança e integração dos processos.

Atividades principais

  • Gerenciar projetos de inovação, digitalização e automação de processos industriais.
  • Atuar como referência técnica, orientando equipes locais e globais, promovendo boas práticas e disseminando conhecimento.
  • Garantir a conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação, proteção de dados e compliance.
  • Administrar contratos, custos e orçamentos da área de TI.
  • Realizar a gestão de softwares, licenças e integrações entre sistemas corporativos (SAP, Senior, BI, Portais, etc.).
  • Propor soluções de BI, analytics, bots, powerapps e outras tecnologias para otimizar a produção, gestão de recursos e tomada de decisão.
  • Desenvolver e validar planos de contingência, assegurando a disponibilidade dos sistemas críticos.

Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Administração, Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas

Desejável Especialização Tecnologia da Informação, Gestão de Projetos, Gestão Empresarial, Indústria 4.0, Produção de Celulose

Sobre a UPX:

Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.

Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDoS, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.

title: Senior Data Administrator
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Senior Data Administrator who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid (with the possibility of 100% remote) , in the city of Londrina.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES *

Main Responsibilities

● Data Modeling: Design, develop, and maintain relational and multidimensional data models to meet the requirements of transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP/Data Warehouse) systems.

● Metadata Management: Manage the data catalog, defining business concepts, maintaining data lineage, and ensuring that metadata is clear and accessible.

● Data Quality: Implement and monitor data quality rules, identify anomalies, and collaborate with business and development teams to correct inconsistencies.

● Data Governance: Support the creation, curation, and evolution of best practice guides and standards for data modeling and integration, ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulations such as the LGPD (Brazilian General Data Protection Law).

● Implementation and Curation: Create and curate physical data models in databases, ensuring that the implementation is aligned with the logical design.

● Technical Collaboration: Act as a point of reference for development, BI, and data science teams, offering support and expertise on issues related to data structure and access.

Nice to Have:

● Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) applied to data projects (DataOps).

● Knowledge of other data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation). ● Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), especially with database and data lake services.

● Advanced or fluent English for collaboration with global teams.

● Previous experience in the company's sector (e.g., finance, retail, industry).

JOB REQUIREMENTS

MINIMUM REQUIREMENT FOR THE POSITION * DESIRABLE

Education Experience

Minimum Education and Experience

● Education: Completed and proven higher education in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related fields. Short courses or predominantly online courses will not be considered as primary education.

● Experience: Minimum of 6 years of market experience, working directly with data modeling, administration, and governance.

● Professional Stability: Average of 2 years of tenure in previous jobs, according to resume history. Certifications (Desirable)

● At least one active certification, such as:

○ DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) - Associate or Practitioner level.

○ Certification in specific tools (e.g., Informatica, Oracle).

Technical Skills

Technical Skills (Hard Skills)

● Proficiency in relational (3NF) and dimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake) data modeling.

Requisitos:

  • Formação técnica ou tecnólogo em Metalurgia, Mecânica ou Química.
  • Experiência em metalurgia aplicada a tratamento térmico, siderurgia, forjaria ou fundição.
  • Domínio em preparação metalográfica.
  • Vivência com ataque químico e interpretação de microestruturas.
  • Conhecimento em medições de dureza e uso de durometro, microscópio óptico, micrômetro e relógio comparador.
  • Leitura e interpretação de diagramas TTT e CCT.
  • Conhecimento em normas ASTM, ABNT, CQI-9 e IATF.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos.

title: Senior Accounting Consultant
description:
(Hybrid – São Paulo)

Join NFQ!

We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric.

As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for an experienced and proactive Accounting Senior Consultant to join our team in São Paulo (Hybrid). What You’ll Do

  • Review accounting results in both technical test and UAT phases to ensure correctness and compliance.
  • Create and maintain functional and technical documentation in Confluence.
  • Support post-production activities (“babysitting”) to ensure stability and accuracy of accounting flows.
  • Assist the squad with accounting questions related to derivative products (e.g., IRS, CCS, IFN, FRA, C&E).
  • Participate in the design and execution of accounting integration processes between front-office / trade systems and accounting systems.
  • Collaborate with developers and product teams to translate accounting rules into technical solutions and test cases.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience working with Oracle and PL/SQL development, focused on accounting solutions.
  • Proven experience in treasury and derivatives accounting (IRS, CCS, IFN, FRA, C&E, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals: debit/credit, balance sheet, revaluation, FX differences, provisioning, etc.
  • Experience with accounting integration processes and previous experience in banking or treasury environments.
  • Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, DevOps (user level) and GitHub .
  • Excellent communication skills, strong teamwork orientation, and high sense of ownership.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Backoffice systems and Accounting & Management Architecture.
  • Experience automating accounting processes or integrating disparate accounting systems.
  • Advanced Spanish (written and spoken).
  • Prior exposure to QA/UAT automation, monitoring of accounting flows, or working with accounting reconciliation tools.

What We Offer

title: Analista de Redes e Telecomunicações Senior
description:
Faça parte da revolução na produtividade do canavial brasileiro e impulsione a bioenergia rumo a um mundo descarbonizado!

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Redes e Telecomunicações Senior para compor o nosso time de TI

Este profissional garantirá a excelência operacional, a segurança e a evolução contínua da infraestrutura de rede e telecomunicações. Sua missão é projetar, implementar e manter um ambiente de conectividade robusto, escalável e de alta disponibilidade, assegurando que os sistemas de comunicação estejam sempre alinhados com os objetivos de negócio e protegidos contra ameaças, atuando como peça fundamental para a produtividade e inovação da empresa.

Este profissional será responsável por garantir a excelência, segurança e evolução estratégica da infraestrutura de rede e telecomunicações corporativa. Atuará de forma autônoma e proativa , liderando iniciativas de melhoria contínua, otimizando desempenho e assegurando a disponibilidade e resiliência dos serviços de conectividade essenciais ao negócio. Além da operação técnica, será parceiro das áreas de tecnologia e negócio na definição de soluções inovadoras e escaláveis, bem como no relacionamento com fornecedores estratégicos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetura e Planejamento: Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, VPNs e Data Centers), garantindo alta disponibilidade, desempenho, segurança e escalabilidade.
  • Pesquisa e Avaliação: Pesquisar e avaliar novas tecnologias, ferramentas e fornecedores para aprimorar a infraestrutura e a eficiência operacional.
  • Monitoramento e Performance: Implementar e otimizar soluções de monitoramento e gestão de rede (Zabbix, PRTG ou similares), realizando análises de capacidade, tendências e planos de melhoria contínua.
  • Segurança e Conformidade: Administrar e aprimorar soluções de segurança de rede (firewalls de próxima geração, IDS/IPS, NAC, segmentação e políticas de acesso), garantindo conformidade com normas internas e regulatórias.
  • Telefonia e Comunicação Unificada: Gerenciar plataformas de comunicação (VoIP, PABX, Contact Center, MS Teams, Zoom ou similares), assegurando integração com os sistemas corporativos e qualidade nas comunicações.
  • Manutenção e Atualização: Planejar e executar manutenções preventivas, atualizações de firmware/software e gerenciamento de ciclo de vida dos equipamentos (roteadores, switches, firewalls, load balancers, PABX, etc.).
  • Indicadores (KPIs): Definir, monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (latência, throughput, disponibilidade, MTTR), elaborando relatórios gerenciais e propondo planos de ação para melhoria contínua.
  • Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Atuar na gestão técnica e operacional de contratos e parceiros de telecomunicações, acompanhando níveis de serviço (SLAs), desempenho e suporte especializado.
  • Documentação e Melhores Práticas: Possuir alta capacidade de organização para criar, manter e gerenciar a documentação técnica e de arquitetura de rede (diagramas lógicos e físicos, inventário detalhado, planos de endereçamento IP).

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Redes, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência sólida em administração e projetos de redes e telecomunicações corporativas.
  • Certificações técnicas CCNA, FCP ou equivalentes obrigatórias.
  • Conhecimento avançado em protocolos e tecnologias de rede (TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, VLANs, VPNs, QoS, SD-WAN e WLAN corporativa).
  • Experiência com firewalls de próxima geração , balanceadores de carga e soluções de alta disponibilidade.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma, liderar tecnicamente projetos e propor soluções estratégicas.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de relacionamento com diferentes áreas e fornecedores.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, NSE4+ ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com ambientes de nuvem híbrida (AWS, Azure, OCI) e interconexões seguras (VPN, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect).
  • Conhecimento em automação de redes (Ansible, Python, APIs REST).
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta criticidade e missão crítica (indústria, utilities, financeiro ou similar).

Localização:

Piracicaba/SP — Regime Presencial

title: Senior Installation Analysis Engineer
description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Installation Analysis discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the Installation Analysis discipline. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer solves complex problems and uses discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the Installation Analysis team and other related teams and ensures they work within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Direct Engineering team when assigned as a Project Coordinator on projects
  • Apply knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
  • Manage own time to meet agreed deadlines and budgets and develop plans for short-term work activities in own area
  • Communicate and explain complex issues and work to establish understanding
  • Provide engineering support onboard installation vessels offshore, when required to do so
  • Be fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address the issues
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for Variation Orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close cooperation with other engineering disciplines, Planning, Fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in the preparation of estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and workhour estimates
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare Discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications, as required
  • Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Construction/Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare and review design reports
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • When assigned, assist procurement personnel in producing Discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing and reviewing requisitions, evaluating technical quotations and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Check engineering performed by others within the Discipline
  • Perform design verification through single-discipline check/inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Lead engineer apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary, and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Participate in internal, Customer, and third-party technical audits on engineering deliverables and vendor documents
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
  • Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, design calculations, software, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, technical queries, etc.
  • Be aware of costs related to own work and of the discipline
  • In the Pipeline installation discipline, perform/review Pipeline Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for transportation and installation:
  • Submarine pipelines
  • Risers
  • Spools
  • PLETS and manifolds
  • Cables
  • In the Structural Installation discipline, perform/review Structural Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • In the Naval Installation discipline, perform /review Naval Architecture Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures related to all aspects of marine operations covering loadout, transportation, and installation
  • Additional skills (preferred, not mandatory) - perform/review designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures such as:
  • Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures
  • Loadout procedures and guidance during the operations
  • Construction lift analyses and procedures for activities such as floatover, stackings roll-ups, etc.
  • Weighing procedures
  • Design and detailing of miscellaneous fabrication yard items
  • Crane arrangements and rigging arrangements
  • Trailer arrangements/operations, including drawings and procedures

Reports to: Discipline Lead Engineer

Liaise With: All Engineering disciplines, Fabrication Group, Safety Dept, Document Control, Procurement Group,

Subcontractors, Project Management Team, Vendors, and Customers

Supervises: Engineers

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master's degree preferred)
  • 8-15 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Strong working knowledge of many design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the content and application of standards codes and guidelines as applicable for onshore and offshore construction
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Senior Manager Data Science
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior Manager of Data Science.

  • Are you an experienced leader in Data Science ready for your next-level adventure?
  • Does the thought of working with one of the most comprehensive employment data sets in the world excite you?
  • Are you inspired by transformation and making an impact on the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you a technologist first and foremost who approaches every problem wearing that hat while going out of your way to champion creativity and build diverse, productive, and engaged teams?

IMPORTANT: Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location, It is necessary to live nearby.

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

In this role, you'll have access to the most unique and one of the largest HCM data sets and do exploratory analysis to understand if it meets project requirements. It's more than digits and dials - you're making huge decisions that impact millions of customers.

Every day you'll work with multiple stakeholders to identify, design, develop and implement advanced AI and machine learning projects that influence daily life of working people. You'll work with your team to provide, interpret, and predict necessary metrics for decision-making. You'll code with machine learning tools like Python, R, and Scala to synthesize millions of data sets into patterns that answer ad hoc requests and then use Tableau for data visualization. You will create models that guide professional through daily working decisions related to every aspect of working life.

To thrive in this career, you should know how to identify errors and reactively fix them. You'll need to have some formal education in quantitative analytics and know design patterns and data structures. You have the skills to create new models using the technologies above. You will coach and mentor junior data scientists with different strengths to solve various problems with different methodologies and analyses. But given the scale of our data sets and the complex problems we give you to solve, you will stay challenged and engaged with years of exciting projects ahead—all while growing your skills and progressing in a rewarding career.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Setup, Build and Grow the Team. You will work in close collaboration with the USA Data Science and Machine Learning team to setup the goals and roadmap to assemble a world-class team in close alignment with the company’s OKRs.
  • Own and Manage Projects. You will identify, design, develop, and implement advanced analytical projects.
  • You will design, implement and deploy high-performing machine learning/AI models and create API endpoints in AWS.
  • Advanced Analytics & Predictive Modeling. You bring prior experience to the role of formulating problems, extracting & analyzing data from multiple systems, summarizing critical findings/insights, and developing a compelling visual representation of analyses with actionable recommendations—this will set you up for success on Day 1. You will interact with developer, UX designer, product manager, and senior executives to understand problem domain, project requirements, users experience and demonstrate model performance and its business value
  • Limitless Possibilities. You will continue learning and discovering new ways to leverage ADP data to create new products and services and find more insights. You are passionate about learning and applying new techniques within data science that leads to innovations.
  • Collaboration and Communication. You'll be part of a collaborative team, listening to needs, then finding and sharing solutions. You're comfortable and skilled at presenting to both peers and leadership on your projects and findings.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • PhD in quantitative area and 8+ years’ experience in Data Science or related field is required, with at least 4 years’ experience as a Team Leader.
  • Prior experience in Python, SQL, LMM, IA and distributed computing tools such as Databricks, AWS or other Cloud platforms; Well versed with Scikit-learn, PyTorch or other machine learning libraries and platforms.

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

*Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.

title: SAP Specialist - HCM - SuccessFactors
description:
Job Overview

The SAP/SuccessFactors Specialist will be part of ADM’s Service Delivery Organization , responsible for ensuring high system availability and reliable operations across all ADM systems.

In this role, you will analyze and resolve user tickets, collaborate with internal teams and third-party providers, and ensure timely resolution within defined Operational and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) .

You will also partner with architects, developers, and testers to design and deliver small enhancements aligned with the global template, following approval from the Solution Delivery Organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide deep functional and technical expertise in the respective process area, with solid understanding of key integration points across modules and technical components.
  • Take full ownership of support tickets within your process area; collaborate with integration, development, and external support teams to ensure timely resolution within SLA limits.
  • Maintain integrity of the global and regional templates designed by Solution Delivery teams while resolving incidents.
  • Conduct thorough testing — including regression testing — before final user validation and release.
  • Adhere to ADM IT processes and Service Management standards, ensuring accurate and up-to-date ticket documentation.
  • Design and configure minor system enhancements, following ADM’s configuration and naming standards, and document functional design specifications.
  • Support audit and compliance requests by providing accurate and timely technical inputs.
  • Ensure all activities comply with regulatory, security, and ADM policy requirements .
  • Partner with global process and system experts to identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities in business processes.

Job Requirements

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
About the Company

Diib is a company based out of Salt Lake City, Utah. Diib’s mission is to make internet marketing clearer for individuals who don’t know anything about it. Diib helps small and medium businesses to find new ways to grow with Actionable Analytics, Industry-Based Ranking, and Custom Learning Tracks. 250k websites use Diib. The product is AI for SEO and other internet marketing aspects.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer who is passionate about delivering high-quality software, ensuring robust system performance, and driving automation best practices. In this role, you will take ownership of end-to-end testing strategies, leveraging Python for comprehensive test automation across functional, non-functional, and white-box testing. You will also play a key role in maintaining monitoring systems to proactively identify issues in production environments.

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Framework Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable end-to-end (E2E) tests using Python, Playwright, and Pytest for both UI and API validation.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) to support continuous delivery and provide fast feedback.
  • Implement and manage test data and environments to ensure reliable and repeatable test execution.

Test Planning & Strategy

  • Design, document, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define quality benchmarks and ensure test coverage for all requirements.

Functional and Non-Functional Testing

  • Execute detailed automated and manual tests across multiple platforms and devices to validate functionality, usability, and performance.
  • Ensure that systems meet reliability, scalability, and availability expectations, especially in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) .

White-box Testing

  • Work closely with developers to understand internal logic and architecture, enabling more effective code-level testing.
  • Utilize Python scripts to facilitate unit, integration, and service-level testing beyond traditional black-box methods.

Monitoring System Configuration

  • Manage application and infrastructure monitoring tools.
  • Establish alerts and dashboards to support proactive issue resolution and maintain uptime.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing.
  • 3+ years of proficiency in Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development.
  • Demonstrable experience with modern testing frameworks/tools like Playwright and Pytest for effective and reliable E2E and API testing.
  • Proven experience working with and testing applications deployed in a Cloud Environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) .
  • Solid experience setting up and maintaining test execution within CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) .
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Good knowledge of SQL is a must.
  • Familiarity with modern monitoring platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Datadog, or similar).
  • Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

Nice to have

  • Proficiency in performance and security testing tools (e.g., JMeter, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite).
  • Experience in testing data pipelines or data warehouse solutions , particularly Amazon Redshift .
  • Familiarity with testing applications built on AI/ML platforms , such as AWS Bedrock (e.g., prompt validation, knowledge base testing, or guardrail evaluation).

What We Offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

WHY TEACH AT AVENUES?

Avenues | The World School prepares students for engaged global citizenship during a time of unprecedented complexity and accelerating change, combining language immersion, interdisciplinary learning, a global curriculum, and a culture of creativity and deep collaboration.

DEEP COLLABORATION, CONSTANT EVOLUTION

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams design learning experiences together. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.

SECONDARY DIVISION

The Middle and Upper Grades are where our ambitious goals for Avenues graduates, defined in our mission statement , are most comprehensively realized. While in grades 6-12, we prepare students for a globally connected, innovation-driven, and largely unknown future. Our students will be: accomplished in all the academic skills you would expect, at ease beyond their borders, and confident because they excel in a particular passion.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Avenues uses a problem-based mathematics pedagogy and curriculum. Math in Middle/Upper grades is taught through a student centered approach, where students discuss to find their solutions, continually reflect on mistakes and master mathematical concepts through working out problems together. Teachers facilitate discourse in class to guide students to deeper understanding of mathematics. You will also:

● Ensure that students achieve key learning outcomes, targeting instruction to address individual needs

● Build a learning atmosphere that leads students to feel part of a rigorous, dynamic, and joyful learning community

● Collaborate intensively with colleagues to continually deepen student learning

● Inspire trust and confidence among parents and families

Qualifications

Math teachers at Avenues bring all or most of the following:

● A remarkable entrepreneurial drive, creativity and ability to bring new ideas to fruition

● Intellectual curiosity and humility, to reflect on and continually grow in teaching practice

● Strong content knowledge in math

● Pedagogy that engages all students in interesting, meaningful and challenging work

● Experience teaching math, with clear evidence of student learning and growth

● A strong sense of personal responsibility for the success of every student

title: Front End Engineer (Sanity)
description:
Join Our Client as a Front End Engineer (Sanity)

About the Organisation


Our Client operates within the digital technology space, delivering innovative solutions that shape the future of online experiences. Renowned for their collaborative culture and commitment to growth, they foster a dynamic environment where creativity and technical excellence thrive. Recognised for leading-edge projects and a supportive community, it's an excellent place to develop your career and make a meaningful impact.
Role Overview
Due to an exciting expansion driven by strategic initiatives, our Client is seeking a talented Front End Engineer with expertise in SanityCMS. This role is key to enhancing their digital presence and delivering seamless user experiences. It offers a unique chance to embed yourself in innovative projects that influence global digital platforms. If you are passionate about modern front-end development and eager to push boundaries, this opportunity is perfect for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain responsive, accessible web interfaces using React and TypeScript, aligning with best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate design concepts into functional web components.
  • Integrate and optimise SanityCMS to ensure content management is efficient and user-friendly.
  • Write clean, maintainable code in HTML, CSS, and TS, ensuring optimal performance across browsers and devices.
  • Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and refining performance to uphold high-quality standards.
  • Contribute to continual improvement of development processes and technical documentation.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience building front-end applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5/CSS3 for crafting responsive and accessible layouts.
  • Hands-on experience with SanityCMS or similar headless CMS solutions.
  • Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within a team and follow clear technical guidance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and quality.


Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Additional experience with other JavaScript frameworks or libraries.
  • Knowledge of build tools and package managers like Webpack, npm, or Yarn.
  • Understanding of SEO best practices and performance optimisation techniques.
  • Experience with agile development methodologies.
  • Knowledge of UI/UX principles and graphic design tools.


Ready to Make an Impact?


If you are excited by the prospect of developing cutting-edge digital experiences and meet the essential criteria, we encourage you to submit your CV today. Join our Client's journey to innovate and shape the future of online content delivery.

title: Analista de Planejamento (ASA)
description:
Sobre a Gruen

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.

Objetivo do Cargo: O(a) profissional será responsável pelo planejamento, controle e acompanhamento das atividades de assistência técnica nos ativos dos projetos, assegurando que os atendimentos sejam realizados com eficiência, qualidade e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.

Atribuições:

  • Planejar obras com foco em tubulação, incluindo cortes, soldas, montagem de tubulações, skids e interligações entre equipamentos.
  • Atuar no planejamento técnico de projetos para implantação de plantas de biometano.
  • Planejar ações de assistência técnica e definir estratégias de mobilização de recursos (mão de obra, materiais e equipamentos).
  • Elaborar e acompanhar cronogramas técnicos integrando fornecedores, instaladores e equipes internas.
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e garantir comunicação eficaz entre equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Acompanhar a execução dos serviços em campo, assegurando qualidade, segurança e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Emitir relatórios técnicos e dashboards de acompanhamento.
  • Realizar follow-up com fornecedores e terceiros para garantir entregas no prazo.
  • Apoiar a padronização de processos e documentação técnica.
  • Tratar não conformidades e acompanhar ações corretivas no período inicial de operação dos ativos.

Requisitos:

  • Formação técnica ou superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção, Projetos Industriais ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência em planejamento e execução de projetos industriais (de preferência no setor de energia, gás, petróleo, biogás/biometano).
  • Conhecimentos em cronogramas, ferramentas de planejamento (MS Project, Primavera, Excel avançado ou similares).
  • Familiaridade com processos de comissionamento, start-up e assistência técnica em campo.
  • Boa capacidade de organização, comunicação e trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em planejamento de obras, preferencialmente com foco em tubulação.

Benefícios

  • Regime de contrato CLT.
  • Salário competitivo ao do mercado.
  • Vale transporte.
  • Vale refeição.
  • Plano de saúde.
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de vida

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

Analista de Cobrança e Retenção – DS.Marketing

Como Analista de Cobrança e Retenção, você será responsável por conduzir o relacionamento com clientes em momentos críticos do ciclo, especialmente em situações de inadimplência, desalinhamento de expectativas ou perda momentânea de percepção de valor.

Seu papel é estratégico: garantir que o cliente mantenha clareza sobre seu plano de crescimento, entenda os próximos passos e execute corretamente a jornada para renovar e recomprar com previsibilidade.

Nesta função, você atuará com abordagem consultiva, combinando princípios de Customer Success, operações de cobrança, recuperação de crédito e gestão de objeções, sempre com foco na manutenção da receita e saúde da carteira.

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir contatos ativos e receptivos com clientes em atraso, risco de churn ou perda de percepção de valor.
  • Identificar a causa raiz da inadimplência (financeira, técnica, operacional ou de expectativa) e propor caminhos realistas de regularização.
  • Resgatar a visão estratégica do cliente, conectando o plano contratado aos resultados esperados.
  • Estruturar negociações e acordos financeiros que permitam continuidade saudável do contrato.
  • Controlar objeções com técnica e empatia, garantindo que o cliente se sinta acompanhado e orientado.
  • Executar rotinas de cobrança consultiva, evitando processos mecânicos e focando no impacto do plano no negócio do cliente.
  • Acompanhar SLAs de contatos, follow-ups, acordos e compromissos assumidos.
  • Mapear riscos de cancelamento e agir preventivamente para evitar churn.
  • Alimentar o CRM com histórico, status, acordos e próximos passos, mantendo previsibilidade e organização.
  • Colaborar com times internos (CS, financeiro, comercial e operações) na construção de rotinas que melhorem retenção e adimplência.

title: Creative Director
description:
SOBRE A NÓS:

A DigiPlus Interactive Corp., líder em entretenimento digital nas Filipinas, chegou ao Brasil! Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2025 com o lançamento oficial da DigiPlus Brasil Interactive Ltda., e já estamos 100% licenciados para oferecer experiências inovadoras no mercado de iGaming. Estamos trazendo o sucesso de plataformas renomadas, como a BingoPlus para criar novas oportunidades e experiências incríveis para os brasileiros.

Junte-se a nós e embarque nessa jornada de inovação e diversão!

SOBRE A VAGA:

Como Diretor Criativo você terá papel essencial na criação de Branding sendo responsável por liderar toda a visão criativa da DigiPlus no Brasil para suas marcas de iGaming, sua missão é assegurar excelencia, consistência, qualidade sem perder a velocidade em todas as entregas de design para Marketing e Operações. Você irá mentorar e coordena um time multidisciplinar (design gráfico, motion e criação para CRM), irá definir padrões visuais, organizar fluxos de trabalho e quando necessário, irá atuar na execução de projetos criativos de alto impacto para o negócio.

Esta função exige liderança criativa, domínio técnico e de ferramentas de gestão, habilidade estratégica de priorização e forte entendimento do setor de iGaming.

Inglês avançado é obrigatório para interface com time global.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

Liderança Criativa

• Definir a direção visual da marca: garantir consistência em todas as frentes com foco em fazer com o que o Produto tenha uma identidade visual impactante no mercado brasileiro.

• Liderar brainstorms, criação de conceitos, key visuals, storyboards e peças de alto impacto.

• Desenvolver o conceito criativo de cada produto, pensando em inovação para inserção no mercado brasileiro.

• Atuar diretamente na criação de campanhas-chave e entregas complexas.

Gestão de Time & Operações

• Coordenar e desenvolver designers gráficos, motion designers e criadores de assets para CRM.

  • Desenvolver prazos e coordenar SLAs do setor de Criação.

• Desenvolver com equipe de Markting o sistema centralizado de tickets, visando como resultado priorizar entregas conforme SLAs (same day, 48h, etc.).

• Desenvolver controle de qualidade e garantir cumprimento de prazos e organização do fluxo de trabalho.

• Criar e manter templates, guias de marca e sistemas visuais.

Colaboração com Marketing

• Performance & Aquisição: supervisionar o desenvolvimento de artes para anúncios, banners, landing pages e app stores.

• Parcerias: Orientar materiais co-branded e peças para integração com parceiros.

• Brand: Liderar a criação de de canais OOH, patrocínios, rádio, campanhas institucionais.

• Conteúdo & Comunidade: Definir estratégias junto com equipe de marketing para criativos para redes sociais, lives, comunidades e transmissões.

Colaboração com Operações

• Casino Operations: campanhas, torneios, programas de fidelidade e conteúdo onsite.

• Sportsbook Operations: boosts, ofertas diárias, campanhas alinhadas ao calendário esportivo.

• CRM & Retenção: e-mail, push, SMS e WhatsApp.

• VIP: peças para jogadores de alto valor e comunicações exclusivas.

Execução e Qualidade

• Fazer revisão final de todas as peças antes da publicação.

• Garantir aderência às diretrizes de marca e às normas regulatórias.

• Estabelecer, organizar e manter a governança de bibliotecas de ativos e materiais de marca.

• Garantir que todas as peças produzidas atendam a regulamentação do setor mantendo um fluxo de revisão e aprovação com o compliance.

Inovação

• Monitorar tendências de design, motion e iGaming.

• Integrar ferramentas de IA para acelerar processos criativos.

• Propor novos formatos e soluções criativas para aumentar performance.

PROCURAMOS ALGUÉM QUE TENHA:

• Experiência de 5+ anos em funções seniores de design ou direção de arte (agência, gaming, tecnologia ou entretenimento).

• Experiência comprovada liderando equipes criativas e grandes volumes de produção.

• Vivência com design orientado a performance e produção recorrente de materiais digitais.

• Experiência prévia em marcas de ritmo acelerado ou operações de alto volume.

  • Gestão de equipes de inovação.
  • Resultados comprovados - necessário envio do portifólio na etapa inicial do processo.
  • Inglês avançado.

Habilidades Técnicas

• Domínio avançado de Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere).

• Experiência com Figma para layouts, sistemas e organização de templates.

• Noções de motion design (mesmo que não seja executor principal).

• Conhecimento de fluxos e padrões visuais de casino e sportsbook.

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA (Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, etc.).

Habilidades Comportamentais

• Liderança inspiradora e foco em desenvolvimento de equipe.

• Excelente senso estético, narrativa visual e atenção a detalhes.

• Forte capacidade de priorização e gestão sob pressão.

• Comunicação clara com áreas diversas e não criativas.

• Perfil organizado, proativo e orientado a solução.

KPIs

• Cumprimento de SLAs.

• Qualidade e consistência das entregas.

• Eficiência operacional do time de design.

• Satisfação das áreas internas (Marketing e Operações).

• Impacto direto das peças em campanhas e ações.

• Otimização e ganho de velocidade via templates, processos e IA.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR AQUI:

  • Ambiente global e inovador do mercado de Igaming;

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for mapping and applying for the possible grants and sponsorships from government laws, planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in data keeping and administration as well as event planning . The Officer will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.

Responsibilities:

  • Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school’s financial and development goals.
  • Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events.
  • Donor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with potential and current donors, sponsors, and partners. Develop and implement donor recognition programs.
  • Research, identify, and apply for grants and sponsorship opportunities that align with the school’s mission (Ex: “Lei de incentivo ao esporte”).
  • Alumni Engagement: Work with alumni to foster lifelong connections to the school and to encourage giving.

  • Reporting & Data Management: Maintain accurate records of fundraising activities, donor contributions, and financial reports. Provide regular updates on fundraising progress to leadership.
  • Budget Management: Track and manage the fundraising budget, ensuring cost-effective planning and execution of events and initiatives.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, or a related field.
  • English fluency is essential for this position, as communication with international stakeholders will be a core part of the role.

*Best to have experience in fundraising, development, or a similar role, preferably in an educational or nonprofit environment. Ideally this person would understand the Brazilian Government bureaucracy regarding “Leis de incentivo”

title: Sales representative
description:
ABOUT US

Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE

We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline
  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion
  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach
  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions
  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 1+ years of commission sales experience
  • Strong
  • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability
  • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses
  • Remote-friendly work environment
  • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development
  • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Especialista de Logística - Planejamento S&OE
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

Desafios:

Liderar e otimizar o alinhamento de curto prazo entre as áreas de Vendas, Operações (Produção) e Logística atuando como elo central na tomada de decisões táticas, garantindo que a execução do plano de produção esteja perfeitamente sincronizada com a demanda do mercado, o estoque disponível e a capacidade de expedição, maximizando a rentabilidade, garantindo o nível de serviço ao cliente e otimizando a eficiência da cadeia, visualizando um horizonte de planejamento de 3 a 18 meses.

Principais Atividades:

- Liderar o ciclo de reuniões de S&OE, atuando como facilitador entre Vendas, Produção, Logística e demais áreas;

- Consolidar informações de demanda, capacidade, restrições e estoque, garantindo um plano integrado e alinhado aos objetivos da empresa;

- Gerenciar prioridades e conflitos entre áreas, assegurando decisões ágeis e estratégicas;

- Analisar e melhorar continuamente o desempenho dos planos de S&OE, propondo ações corretivas;

- Replanejar produção e estoques diante de mudanças de mercado ou imprevistos operacionais;

- Desenvolver análises e simulações de cenários para apoiar decisões de curto prazo;

- Definir, monitorar e reportar KPIs como acuracidade da previsão, nível de estoque, OTD e eficiência produtiva;

- Preparar e apresentar relatórios e dashboards gerenciais sobre desempenho da cadeia de suprimentos;

- Ser ponto focal dos sistemas de planejamento (ERP, APS) e garantir integridade dos dados;

- Atuar na identificação e implementação de melhorias nos processos de S&OE, buscando agilidade, precisão e automação;

- Assegurar o cumprimento das políticas de Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Segurança, Ética e Compliance.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

- Ensino super completo em Administração, Engenharias e/ou áreas afins;

- Especialização em Logística empresarial, Papel e Celulose, Supply Chain Management ou Equivalente;

- Conhecimento com Planejamento de demanda, Logística Integrada, Processos portuários, ERP/Sistemas, KPIs e performance, e Excel avançado;

- Vivência em indústrias de processo contínuo, como papel e celulose, química, mineração, siderurgia, alimentos, automotivo, varejo alta escala ou petroquímica;

- Conhecimento em sistemas de planejamento (ERP, APS) e ferramentas de análise de dados;

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.

The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

title: Comprador II - Projetos

Comprador II - Projetos

Local: Eusébio/CE ou Jaboatão dos Guararapes/PE

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Temos mais de 17 mil colaboradores, 21 unidades no Brasil, 1 no Uruguai e 28 centros de distribuição, que garantem nossa presença no Brasil e em mais de 40 países pelo mundo.

Nossa atuação e cultura

Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, por acreditarmos que ela impulsiona resultados e transformações. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados e reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual.

Missão do Cargo:

Desempenhar atividades relacionadas ao ciclo de compras, com foco em projetos estratégicos e de gerenciamento de categoria (como matérias primas, inovação ou CAPEX).

O objetivo é garantir a aquisição de bens e serviços de forma eficiente, alinhada à visão da empresa, às melhores práticas de mercado e aos requisitos de cada projeto.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Seus desafios serão:

  • Conduzir o processo de compras de ponta a ponta para projetos específicos, incluindo a cotaçã, negociação de preços e prazos com fornecedores, e emissão de pedidos.
  • Contribuir para a análise de mercado de fornecedores, identificando novas oportunidades e tecnologias para otimizar os custos e a qualidade dos projetos.
  • Focar no entendimento macro das necessidades do cliente interno e externo relacionadas a cada projeto, garantindo que as compras atendam aos requisitos de qualidade, prazo e custo.
  • Entender todos os pontos que possam gerar interdependência entre as áreas (engenharia, produção, financeiro, etc.) para garantir a fluidez do processo de compras do projeto.
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para formalização das compras, como a análise de propostas, mapas de concorrência e contratos de fornecimento.
  • Participar ativamente de projetos de reestruturação da cadeia de suprimentos ou outros projetos estratégicos, conforme diretrizes do comitê estratégico.
  • Conduzir entrevistas e reuniões de alinhamento com as áreas técnicas para detalhar escopos e requisitos de compras de projetos.
  • Elaborar relatórios com a representação do cenário atual e proposta de cenário futuro do processo de compras, identificando gaps e ações de melhoria.
  • Apoiar a adequação da estrutura organizacional, através de análises de atividades e papéis relacionados ao fluxo de compras.
  • Coletar e organizar a documentação necessária para análises de desempenho dos fornecedores e dos processos de compras.
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos requisitos de sustentabilidade, gestão da qualidade, segurança de alimentos, meio ambiente e segurança e saúde ocupacional.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável pós-graduação em áreas afins, como Gestão de Projetos ou Supply Chain.

Será um diferencial se:

  • Pacote Office avançado (Excel, Power BI).
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Conhecimento é experiência prévia com metodologia de Gestão de Projetos, como PMBOK ou Metodologia Ágil.
  • Experiência com SAP (módulo MM - Materials Management) ou outro ERP.
  • Experiência com Trello, planner ou outro sistema de gerenciamento de tarefas.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de negociação.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.

  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
